title: Over 4,800 typhoon-hit Bohol families get aid from NHA
summary: TAGBILARAN CITY, BOHOL, Philippines — Nearly five years after Super Typhoon Odette (international name: Rai) devastated Bohol, thousands of affected families in Catigbian town finally received…

blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, BOHOL, Philippines — Nearly five years after Super Typhoon Odette (international name: Rai) devastated Bohol, thousands of affected families in Catigbian town finally received financial assistance from the government.
